name: MicroSat Bus (Class A)
description: Compact aluminum unibody designed for rapid cube/small sat deployment.

name: Explorer Core Bus (Class B)
description: Versatile medium frame with internal avionics bay and standard instrument mounts.

name: Deep-Voyager Bus (Class C)
description: Heavy-duty radiation-shielded chassis capable of hosting multi-ton science payloads.

name: Standard Fixed Solar Panels (2m²)
description: Body-mounted silicon crystalline panels generating up to 150W at 1 AU.

name: Dual Articulated Solar Wings (6m²)
description: Sun-tracking dual panels generating 450W at 1 AU. Folds during launch.

name: Mega-Array Tracking Wings (15m²)
description: High-efficiency triple-junction GaAs array producing 1100W at 1 AU.

name: GPHS-RTG Deep Space Core
description: General Purpose Heat Source RTG. Produces steady 250W irrespective of solar distance.

name: Lithium-Ion Battery Bank (1.5 kWh)
description: Space-rated secondary cell buffer supporting orbital eclipse periods up to 2.5 hours.

name: Solid-State Li-Sulfur Matrix (4.0 kWh)
description: High energy-density pack providing deep discharge resilience for extended shadowed passes.

name: S-Band Omni + Medium Horn
description: Broad-beam antenna suited for LEO and lunar distances with low pointing requirements.

name: Ka-Band Gimbaled High-Gain Reflector
description: Precision steered 2.4m parabolic dish achieving up to 28 Mbps at interplanetary ranges.

name: RAD750 Single-Board Computer
description: Battle-tested radiation-hardened PowerPC processor with standard telemetry sequencing.

name: Quad-Core HPSC Neuromorphic System
description: High-Performance Spaceflight Computing chip with autonomous hazard avoidance and data compression.

name: 3-Axis Reaction Wheels + Hydrazine RCS
description: Precision momentum management for high instrument pointing accuracy and slewing.

name: Standard Graded-Z Aluminum Shielding
description: Lightweight aerospace alloy layering protecting against primary cosmic rays and low-energy protons.

name: Titanium Welded Monopropellant Tank
description: Surface tension propellant management device storing up to 1000 kg hydrazine.

name: Hypergolic Bipropellant Engine (450N)
description: Monomethylhydrazine / Nitrogen Tetroxide biprop engine. High thrust for fast orbital insertions.

name: NEXT-C Gridded Ion Propulsion Thruster
description: High specific impulse electrostatic xenon engine. Low continuous thrust, outstanding fuel economy.
